villasPage.propertiesBody: Nightly rates and minimum stays are quoted to your dates — the figures below describe layout and standout features only.

villasPage.chauffeurCrosslinkVilla: Chauffeur service is available on request — airport or hotel pickup, timed transfers to your villa, and rides to the marina when you step aboard a yacht.
villasPage.chauffeurCrosslinkYacht: Add chauffeur service so you are picked up on schedule, driven to the marina for embarkation, and returned after your charter.
villasPage.chauffeurCrosslinkJet: Ground legs can match your flight — chauffeur pickup from home, hotel, or the FBO, then onward to your villa, yacht, or meetings.
